title: Reopen a resolved thread without losing ordered discussion
preconditions: Create root comment A and reply B on one slide Item; resolve the thread with explicit action C.

steps.expected_result: A, B and C remain visible in chronological order and open-thread count is zero.

steps.action: Append an explicit reopen action D to the same root thread.
steps.expected_result: The thread is open and its slide open-thread count becomes one.
A, B, C and D remain visible in order with the original slide/Item context.

expected_result: A, B, C and D remain visible in order with the original slide/Item context.
